The XML syntax is fine — tags are properly closed, attributes are quoted, self-closing elements use `/>`.

The one xacro-specific concern worth noting: defining `xacro:property` inside `xacro:if`/`xacro:unless` blocks is valid in modern xacro (ROS 2), but the property's scope is local to the block. If `gripper_closed_position_value` is referenced later in the same file, it must be defined before that reference is evaluated. If the conditional doesn't fire (e.g., both evaluate false due to an unexpected value), the property will be undefined and xacro will throw an error at use time.

Other than that, no XML errors in this snippet.
